report.summary: Both failures are the same test bug: the BooksPage page object clicks a test id `add-books` that does not exist in the app, so Playwright waits 5s and times out before the test body runs. The app template uses `add-book`, so fix the locator in tests/support/pages.py:44 first and both tests should get past this step.

causes.title: Page object uses non-existent test id 'add-books' for the Add book button
causes.explanation: BooksPage.add() clicks get_by_test_id("add-books"), but the Add book button in the books template is data-testid="add-book". The locator never matches, so click() waits for the full 5000 ms timeout and raises. The failure happens at the click, before any assertion, so neither test ever exercises the behavior it is named for. The app is correct here: the button exists and its id is consistent with the other data-testids on the page. The mismatch is a typo in the test support code.
evidence: Failure log for both tests: "Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: - waiting for get_by_test_id("add-books")"
Traceback for test_added_book_is_listed: tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:13 -> tests\support\pages.py:44 in add
Traceback for test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input: tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:42 -> tests\support\pages.py:44 in add
causes.suggested_fix: In tests/support/pages.py line 44, change get_by_test_id("add-books") to get_by_test_id("add-book"). Consider a grep for other mismatched test ids in the page objects while there. Then rerun tests/ui/test_books_ui.py. Once the click works, check whether test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input still passes its error and input-retention assertions; those were never reached in this run, so this report says nothing about them.
